Experienced developer focused on backend and APIs, building scalable services and integrating databases and cloud platforms.

Node.js Developer, GreenGrid — Oct 2024 - Present
At GreenGrid, built and maintained microservices for energy billing and device telemetry ingestion. Implemented TypeScript-based service modules and Express-based HTTP gateways that processed device events and reduced API latency by ~30% for peak loads. Developed GraphQL façade over existing services to enable flexible querying for mobile and web clients. Collaborated with DevOps to deploy services to AWS with automated CI/CD pipelines. Documentation and runbooks maintained in Confluence.

Full Stack Developer, Razorpay — May 2021 - Sep 2024
Worked on payment orchestration and merchant onboarding flows. Led backend development in TypeScript using NestJS for transaction workflows and reconciliation. Designed and optimized MongoDB schemas and indexes to handle high write throughput for payment events, improving query performance for settlements. Built and refactored Express-based internal APIs for integrations with banking partners. Exposed GraphQL endpoints for team consumption and authored Confluence design docs for release handoffs. Participated in AWS cost optimizations and operational runbook creation.

Skills: Node JS, TS, Express, MongoDB, AWS, GraphQL, NestJS, Confluence

Education: B.E., Information Technology, Pune University
